description: Delete your stored memories, like mem0's delete memory and delete all memories. With memory_id: deletes that one memory (404 if it is not yours). Without it: deletes up to 200 of your memories matching user_id, agent_id, app_id or run_id (at least one), and says if more remain. Requires your memory_key (a secret string you generate): other keys cannot delete your memories. Price: $0.002 a call (3 free calls a day without an API key).

agent_id.description: Entity: the agent the memories belong to (1-128 characters)

memory_id.description: UUID of one memory to delete; leave out to delete by entity instead

memory_key.description: Your secret: a random string of 16-256 characters that you generate once and keep (also accepted as the X-Memory-Key header). Memories are stored and searched only under its hash, so nobody who lacks it can read them, whatever user_id they send. Lose it and the memories are unreachable.

run_id.description: Entity: the session or run (1-128 characters)

user_id.description: Entity: the user the memories are about (1-128 characters)

name: delete_memories
